exposure: laparoscopy prior to 8 weeks of gestation
Women with surgically diagnosed adnexal torsion vs. women without adnexal torsion
cohort: Women who underwent urgent laparoscopy for suspected adnexal torsion during pregnancy between 2004 and 2019 at three tertiary medical centers
finding: While pregnancy outcomes following a diagnosis of adnexal torsion were generally favorable, laparoscopy performed before 8 weeks of gestation was associated with a higher miscarriage rate regardless of the presence of adnexal torsion.
